summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Defense to create a program to collaborate with academic institutions to develop cybersecurity education programs, including establishing curriculum standards and promoting community outreach, while consulting with various federal agencies and private sector entities.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to establish cybersecurity education programs, which inherently involves training individuals to protect digital systems and data. While it doesn't directly regulate tech companies or privacy, it contributes to a more skilled workforce capable of enhancing cybersecurity, which indirectly supports data protection and oversight.
